verdict.rationale: Zoho documents a v3 REST API reference and provides a first-party Postman collection so users can try the API, which gives runnable examples. Running them requires downloading the collection into a third-party REST client rather than using the docs page itself, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the tested paths. missing for 10: in-browser interactive 'try it' console in the API reference, runnable examples embedded in the docs, published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: To try out our API, you can use the Postman, a REST client. You can download our API collection and give it a swing.
The Zoho Invoice API allows you to perform all the operations that you do with our web client.
